subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream proof before accepting any recovery path that can turn assistant text into executable tool calls?
rationale: The central bug is credible, but the proposed recovery shapes affect the tool-execution boundary and the current source already handles the reduced reasoning-before-tool_calls sequence.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

options.title: Sponsor vLLM-specific recovery
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned vLLM/gpt-oss recovery design before exact reproduction, with security review and tests proving false text-to-tool promotion cannot occur.

options.title: Defer to provider workaround
options.body: Treat local-model docs and tool_choice/server-template tuning as the supported path only if maintainers decide structured-wire evidence is insufficient for a core fix.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent ownership in OpenAI-compatible reasoning/tool-call stream parsing, which is the decision surface here.
